bullets.text: A gas leak at SIPCOT in Gummidipoondi caused panic among workers, and the office should monitor industrial safety measures.
A van driver was arrested for sexually harassing a five-year-old girl in Sengundram, and the office should verify police action on the initial complaint delay.

The Greater Chennai Corporation repaired 1,531 potholes after rains, and the office should track progress on the remaining road repairs.
Power supply will be suspended in Adambakkam for maintenance work, and the office should ensure residents are notified.
A boiler tube puncture occurred at the North Chennai Thermal Power Station in Athipattu, and the office should watch power generation recovery.
Collector Kavitha invited fishing workers in Thiruvallur to register their personal details, and the office should encourage community participation.
Passengers at Avadi railway station flagged delays in platform reconstruction, and the office should follow up with railway authorities.
ETV Bharat reported on the Periyar Arivulagam AI controversy inquiry, and the office should review the factual findings.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay ordered a ₹2,000-crore allocation for the Vetri Laptop Scheme, and the office should oversee implementation readiness.
Vultr launched a 20 MW AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by AMD GPUs, and the office should welcome this digital infrastructure growth.
The Periyar Arivulagam book procurement controversy escalated as the government formed a panel to inspect libraries, and the office should watch political developments.
Minister Rajmohan alleged AI corruption during the previous regime over book procurement, and the office should monitor related official statements.
